title: Providence of the Trinity for the three royal children
english: For the sake of the royal children of the same race, Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, the providence of the undefiled Trinity worked through the prophecy just now read. About these I wish to explain their way of life, their advocacy, their alliance, and their perfection for the Church of God—how these good noble branches, the children proved their courage and were brought to perfection, and so on.

title: Cyril's own record of the children's symbol and perfection
english: I, Cyril, the least bishop of the city of Alexandria, encountered this construction of the good testament in the testament of Daniel. I wrote down the symbol and way of life of the holy and blameless children, and their perfection in Christ.

title: Closing prayer for the Church's flourishing through the martyrs' intercession
english: May it happen by the grace of Christ and through the intercession of the victorious martyrs just remembered, that the Church of Christ flourishes and advances, thriving in the fruit of righteousness. May fathers and mothers produce such plants with self-control and godliness, and may young men and virgins be counted worthy of such a way of life and grow together in such virtue with one another. The holy children are perfected on the seventeenth of December.
